mission_06: You have implemented Difference-in-Differences estimation, one of the most widely used quasi-experimental methods in applied economics and policy evaluation. The 2x2 estimator, TWFE regression, parallel trends tests, and event study specifications form a complete DiD toolkit. The parallel trends assumption is untestable directly, but you can assess its plausibility by examining pre-treatment trends. Event studies are particularly valuable as they show whether effects appear before treatment (violating parallel trends) and how effects evolve over time. Remember that recent methodological advances have identified biases in TWFE with staggered treatment timing — consider using newer estimators like Callaway-Sant'Anna or Sun-Abraham when treatment timing varies across units.
